source.publicationAuthorization: Project owner authorized continued website publication on 2026-08-29. Independent specialist approval remains a separate project-control field and is not implied by publication.
source.releaseTimeReview: THC-ENC-201–205 were reviewed for cultivar-dependent flowering behavior, non-universal photoperiod thresholds, autoflower variation, preflower interpretation, and botanical architecture terminology. Public wording separates flower initiation from full reproductive development and avoids fixed-day or universal 12/12 claims.
source.note: This batch opens the controlled Flowering & Reproduction topic with developmental staging before later pollen, fertilization, seed-production, senescence, and recordkeeping lessons.
